name: Decky Loader (pinned, verified)
summary: Installs the community plugin loader for the Steam client (Decky Loader v3.3.1) from its official GitHub release, verified by SHA-256, with the same layout as Decky's own installer. Needed only for Decky plugins such as the decky-power-plugins tweak; no other tweak requires it.
restart: Restart Steam (or switch to Gaming Mode) to see the Decky menu in the Quick Access menu.
